name: nitwit
caption: the nitwit finally said something 😳
premise: The village nitwit only ever says 'hmm'. He always stands exactly where something bad is about to happen (a tree before lightning, the wheat before a creeper, the well before it turns to lava), and every other villager walks away from him. The narrator follows him one night past the last torch and finds a burned, empty copy of his own village.
twist: The nitwit is from a world that already ended, sent back to warn this one, and 'hmm' is all the game lets a nitwit say. Today he stands right next to the narrator: the bad thing is about to happen to him. He says the date of the end, and it's today.

lines.text: The NITWIT / in my village / has said HMM / 4,096 TIMES.
Under a TREE. / That night, / LIGHTNING / split it.
In the WHEAT. / A CREEPER / walked in / and BOOM.
By the WELL. / The water / turned to / LAVA.
On MY roof. / The next day, / it rained / ANVILS.
The other / villagers / WALK AWAY / when he comes.
Even the / IRON GOLEM / goes AROUND him.
So one night, / I FOLLOWED him.
Past the / last torch / was ANOTHER / village.
The TREE. / The WHEAT. / The WELL. / All GONE.
He's not / FROM here. / His world / already ENDED.
They sent him / BACK / to WARN us.
But a NITWIT / can only / say one word.
And today, / he's standing / right next / to ME.
He said / my NAME. / Then the DATE / of the END.
